Oneliner

Test CubeSat platform for Moon missions, deployment of 300 m tether for deorbiting and cameras.
Description

Test the deployment of 300 m tether for deorbiting. Test 2 Earth Observation cameras. Test technologies for ESTCube-2, which might go to Moon. High-speed COM module from Ventspils University College. Propulsion module from Nanospace.
